content_en.title: Multi-Branch Barbershop Website
content_en.summary: A redesign for a premium barbershop with five branches, built around its price list and live queues. Customers compare waits across branches, book a chair by barber and time, and keep their haircut notes in a free membership.
content_en.challenge:
The old site opened with a slogan over an interior photo, followed by a cut-off paragraph and a large empty area. Prices sat on a separate page, and every reservation button led to the same WhatsApp number, so customers could not choose a branch, a barber or a time.

Five branches were listed without opening hours, map links or any sign of how busy they were. The free membership and birthday discount were mentioned only in the top bar, the Instagram embed failed to load, and the copy switched between English and Indonesian.
content_en.solution:
The homepage opens as a price board: all six services with prices and durations set in large type, next to the shop interior and a live queue for every branch. Branches are listed like a departure board with chairs, queue length and estimated wait, so customers can pick the branch that is free. Booking is a single column of numbered steps for branch, services, barber and time, with the total and duration in a bar fixed to the bottom of the screen.

The member pass shows the next booking and the birthday discount, followed by style notes written by the barber after each cut, so the result stays consistent at any branch. Inside each shop, a TV queue screen shows every chair, who is next, and which nearby branch is free when the line gets long. The planned production stack is Next.js with Supabase.
features: Price board homepage with services, prices and durations
Live queue and estimated wait for every branch
Branch list in a departure-board layout
Single-column booking for branch, services, barber and time
Free WhatsApp-based membership with a birthday discount
Barber style notes saved after every visit
In-store TV queue screen that suggests a free nearby branch

content_id.title: Website Barbershop Multi-Cabang
content_id.summary: Redesign untuk barbershop premium dengan lima cabang, disusun dari daftar harga dan antrean langsung. Pelanggan membandingkan waktu tunggu antarcabang, booking kursi per kapster dan jam, dan menyimpan catatan potongan lewat member gratis.
content_id.challenge:
Situs lama dibuka dengan slogan di atas foto interior, disusul paragraf yang terpotong dan area kosong yang besar. Harga ada di halaman terpisah, dan semua tombol reservasi mengarah ke nomor WhatsApp yang sama, sehingga pelanggan tidak bisa memilih cabang, kapster, atau jam.

Lima cabang ditampilkan tanpa jam buka, link peta, atau gambaran seberapa ramai. Member gratis dan diskon ulang tahun hanya disebut di top bar, embed Instagram gagal dimuat, dan bahasanya berganti-ganti antara Inggris dan Indonesia.
content_id.solution:
Beranda dibuka sebagai papan harga: enam layanan beserta harga dan durasinya ditulis besar, berdampingan dengan foto interior dan antrean langsung setiap cabang. Cabang ditampilkan seperti papan keberangkatan lengkap dengan jumlah kursi, panjang antrean, dan perkiraan waktu tunggu, sehingga pelanggan bisa memilih cabang yang sedang sepi. Booking berupa satu kolom langkah bernomor untuk cabang, layanan, kapster, dan jam, dengan total dan durasi di bar yang menempel di bawah layar.

Kartu member menampilkan booking berikutnya dan diskon ulang tahun, diikuti catatan gaya yang ditulis kapster setelah setiap potongan, sehingga hasilnya konsisten di cabang mana pun. Di setiap cabang, layar TV antrean menampilkan semua kursi, siapa berikutnya, dan cabang terdekat yang kosong saat antrean panjang. Stack produksi yang direncanakan adalah Next.js dengan Supabase.
features: Beranda papan harga dengan layanan, harga, dan durasi
Antrean langsung dan perkiraan waktu tunggu tiap cabang
Booking satu kolom untuk cabang, layanan, kapster, dan jam
Member gratis berbasis WhatsApp dengan diskon ulang tahun
Catatan gaya dari kapster tersimpan setiap kunjungan
Layar TV antrean di cabang yang menyarankan cabang terdekat yang kosong
